targets.safetyInvariant: Invalid auto-discovery config fails before keeper startup; partial kick/take config cannot silently enable unsafe discovery.
failureModes: warning branches that protect ambiguous config
targets.implementationNotes: Completed with focused guard tests for disabled/no-action discovery, missing defaults, warning-only operator footguns, direct-DEX path/source controls, chain-specific 1inch executor allowlists, gas override keys and bounds, quote-normalized profit floor context, and settlement defaults/gas caps.

targets.safetyInvariant: Malformed Sushi routes fail closed before quote approval or execution calldata is trusted.
targets.implementationNotes: Completed with table-driven route-shape mutations from a single valid fixture; keep future provider-response guards in this suite.

targets.safetyInvariant: Aggregator quotes cannot execute when provider identity, source, native value, route floor, or pool metadata is inconsistent.
targets.implementationNotes: Hardened with nested approveCalldataAggregatorQuoteForExecution and direct DEX approval/binding tests. Remaining uncovered quote-approval-rules branch is the private unsupported-source fallback in resolveDirectDexRouteFields; exported route binding rejects unsupported sources before that fallback is reachable.

targets.safetyInvariant: Discovery approval rejects external takes that do not clear route-derived profit floors or lack raw profitability context.
failureModes: direct DEX source below profitability floor
stats not incremented on rejected profit floor
targets.implementationNotes: Hardened with a focused pure-policy suite covering simple profitability telemetry, raw aggregator/direct-DEX profit-floor approvals and rejects, hybrid fallback missing gas cost, legacy quote-normalized floor rejects, stale floor handling, subsidy approvals, and stats counting. Remaining uncovered branches are defensive fallbacks unreachable through the public wrapper: the direct-DEX raw-context recheck after canApplyRawRoutePolicy, and the route-policy rejection-reason fallback when applyExternalTakeRoutePolicy rejects without a reason.

targets.safetyInvariant: LiFi canary env parsing rejects malformed live-check input instead of running with bad route or allowlist assumptions.
targets.implementationNotes: Completed with direct parser tests in the existing canary unit suite; keep live RPC checks out of this target.

targets.safetyInvariant: DexRouter dispatches only supported liquidity sources, converts slippage consistently, rejects dust amounts, and cannot silently skip Curve or Universal Router error guards.
failureModes: invalid swap parameters and no-op token pairs
1inch malformed amounts, native value, target, retryability, and patching flags
Universal Router slippage percent-to-bps conversion and failure without legacy fallback
legacy Uniswap V3 fallback and failure
Curve missing config/pool lookup and router failure
targets.implementationNotes: Hardened with focused branch tests instead of adding a broad router deps bag. Remaining uncovered branches are low-value optional/default expression fallbacks or defensive BigNumber parse catches that are not reachable through realistic API payloads.

targets.safetyInvariant: Discovery rejects takes when gas cost cannot be priced or exceeds configured native/quote policy.
failureModes: 1inch gas quote empty, retryable, no-route, or thrown failure
Uniswap direct DEX provider unavailable or zero/lower-output tiers
Curve quote provider unavailable or no usable quote
missing gas telemetry requiring read transport
targets.implementationNotes: Hardened with focused evaluateGasPolicy tests for provider/gas/native/quote cap rejects, no-quote approvals, zero-gas profit apportionment, wrapped-native direct pricing, 1inch circuit and failure telemetry, Uniswap fallback/direct-DEX quote selection, and cached Curve provider success/failure. Remaining uncovered branches are defensive/private helper fallbacks that public evaluateGasPolicy source selection prevents or low-value logging/cache-key branches.

targets.safetyInvariant: Take writes choose the intended public/private/relay transport and fail closed on unsupported or unhealthy submission paths.
failureModes: public/private receipt failure after accepted submission
private durable nonce floor persistence failure
relay error response with accepted tx hash
relay explicit error without nonce preservation
targets.implementationNotes: Hardened with startup/config guard tests, public/private receipt failure classification, private durable nonce floor failure handling, relay signer/nonce guards, relay object-form hashes and custom headers, relay error-response accepted-hash preservation, explicit relay error bubbling, and null receipt wrapping. Existing take-write-submission tests cover direct DEX write transport use and accepted-submission pre/post-broadcast classification. Remaining uncovered branches are mostly optional/default expression fallbacks and low-level relay response-shape noise.

targets.safetyInvariant: Reward action tracking refuses unsafe post-auction swaps when DEX config or target resolution is incomplete.
failureModes: transfer dust and transfer failure retry handling
targets.implementationNotes: Hardened with focused RewardActionTracker tests for missing dexProvider, validatePostAuctionDex failure, unresolved target address, legacy/universal-router WETH target fallback, router-level QuoterV2 resolution, default exchange slippage/fee handling, transfer WAD-to-token conversion, dust-transfer removal, transfer failure retry cleanup, unsupported action queue behavior, retry-ceiling cleanup, malformed queue key rejection, and missing-entry removeToken accounting. The suite uses stubbed router/ERC20 boundaries and does not require live swap execution.

targets.safetyInvariant: LP reward collection handles collateral withdrawal and redeemCollateral legs, not only 1:1 quote redemption fixtures.
failureModes: post-withdrawal read failure after collateral tx
targets.implementationNotes: Hardened the bucket-level collector suite with fake-bucket tests for collateral-first reward-equivalent bounds, quote-to-collateral and collateral-to-quote residual legs, collateral reward-action enqueue before post-read, post-withdrawal read failure avoiding a redundant quote fallback, stale collateral redemption rejection cleanup, and dry-run no-submit behavior. Remaining uncovered branches are mostly ingester configuration/default fallbacks, advisory seen-id threshold logging, missing pool.id defense, below-threshold dust pruning, AuctionNotCleared rethrow, and negative-LP accounting guards.

targets.safetyInvariant: Aggregator calldata execution refuses stale, context-mismatched, or below-floor quotes before signing.
targets.implementationNotes: Hardened with pure-helper and prepared-execution tests for pre-broadcast approval rejection telemetry, approved-floor calldata encoding, quote age checks, auction-context drift, fresh-quote floor and route min-out rejects, dry-run preflight, missing router/taker guards, zero-rounded collateral rejection before quote-provider calls, provider quote failure retry metadata, stale quote rejection, ready execution wiring, and post-prepare still-current assertion failure notification. Remaining uncovered branches are optional/default expression fallbacks and low-value telemetry shape branches.

targets.safetyInvariant: Curve quote provider treats zero-output, cache, and quote errors as non-executable route signals.
targets.implementationNotes: Hardened with a narrow exported deps seam for contract construction/decimals and focused real-provider tests covering initialization, configured-pool reporting, cache hit/miss/expiry, symbol lookup, address fallback checks, token-symbol misses, token-index discovery with ETH/WETH normalization, token-in-pool discovery errors, poolExists true/false/throw, no-pool quotes, zero-output quotes, successful quotes, decimals fallback, insufficient-liquidity/revert/generic quote errors, and market-price quote/amount/throw failures. The remaining missed branch is low-value optional-expression noise.

targets.safetyInvariant: Discovery cycle failures are classified and rethrown/logged without hiding broken target resolution.
targets.implementationNotes: Hardened with orchestration-boundary tests covering discovered take handler failure containment and summary accounting, hot auction cache chain-id lookup failure, pool hydration unavailability, and cached malformed take/settlement snapshots rethrowing with phase=targets failure logs. Existing target tests cover invalid discovered take/settlement targets and shared scan cache isolation. Remaining misses are lower-value optional/default branches, telemetry formatting, and hot-cache removal/debug paths.

targets.safetyInvariant: After external-take execution, nonce-consumed fallback cannot accidentally run or report an unsafe arbTake branch.
targets.implementationNotes: Hardened with direct executeTakeDecision tests covering an external take followed by post-take arbTake revalidation, nonce-consumed arbTake receipt failure classification as submittedTransaction/poolStateMayHaveChanged with executedArbTake=false, execution callback classification, and dry-run propagation of nonce-consumed errors. Remaining uncovered branches are broader engine orchestration paths such as skip logging, candidate-loop stop options, and optional/default callback branches.

targets.safetyInvariant: Startup entrypoints resolve daemon loops, run-once mode, and LP reward collection through testable collaborators instead of hard imports.
targets.implementationNotes: Hardened with startup gating tests for no take work, successful/transient/permanent take write transport initialization, run-once live acknowledgement, daemon-loop launch planning, and an extracted LP redeemer resolver covering normalized cache hits, default LP settings, per-pool LP overrides, missing settings, and hydration failure. Remaining misses are mostly hard-imported infinite loop bodies and low-value optional/logging branches.

targets.safetyInvariant: Utility, provider fee-data, and durable nonce fallbacks fail closed or recover deterministically under RPC errors.
failureModes: provider gas price and priority-fee fallback
targets.implementationNotes: Hardened with focused provider and durable nonce tests covering priority-fee RPC usage, EIP-1559 fee calculation, RPC fallback to default priority fee, legacy no-base-fee responses, provider-caught-up durable nonce clearing, and block-height lookup failure preservation. Remaining misses are low-value utility/default-expression branches and broader optional nonce paths.
